concept: Auto Scaling scale-in: deregistration delay and scale-in protection
tests: Preventing long-running connections from being cut during ASG scale-in (choose two).
expected: Increase the target group deregistration delay (connection draining) + scale-in protection / a longer cooldown. Triggers: "uploads are cut off on scale in", "long-running connections".
why_not: Switching the health check from ELB to EC2 removes application-level checks and does not affect draining; replacing ALB with Classic LB is a step back and does not solve draining.
